name: Dream vacation
overview: The story depicts two brothers named Rahim and Rostam who live in Shiraz. The younger brother, who has a better financial situation, invited Rahim's family, who is a retired teacher, to Turkey for the Eid holidays last year and is trying to make amends to the older brother and wants to take Rostam's family to Kish at his own expense this year. Unaware that they are planning to travel to Paris. These two brothers, each of whom has achieved success in the path of knowledge and wealth, stay with their families in a guesthouse in Kish during Nowruz, and difficult and sweet events occur in Kish, which are the beginning of interesting and spectacular adventures.
